title: Space Tech Briefing — August 28, 2026
summary:
Good morning, future explorers and space enthusiasts! Welcome to your essential daily download of everything happening beyond our blue marble. It is Friday, August 28th, 2026, and we've got a fantastic lineup of cosmic news to kickstart your day!

First up, mark your calendars because this Sunday, August 30th, is set to be monumental! NASA's highly anticipated **Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope** is scheduled for launch. This mission, with significant contributions from France's CNES, promises to be truly extraordinary. Its primary objective? To unlock deeper secrets of our universe, pushing the boundaries of what we understand about dark energy, exoplanets, and cosmic evolution. Get ready for a new era of discovery as Roman takes its eyes to the skies!

And speaking of groundbreaking achievements, let's take a moment to look back at a major recent development from just a few days ago. On August 25th, European Space Agency astronaut **Sophie Adenot** made history once again! She successfully completed her second spacewalk, or EVA, becoming the very first European woman to have two extravehicular activities to her name. Alongside fellow astronaut Anil Menon, Sophie's mission involved the critical task of installing a brand-new antenna, replacing the one they had skillfully removed on August 19th. What an incredible display of skill and determination, paving the way for future generations of space explorers!

And that's your morning briefing from the final frontier! Thank you for joining us. Keep looking up, stay curious, and have a stellar day!
